builds.howItPlays: You use Kai'Sa's extra rune, which only pays for spells, to cast two removal spells in a turn, like Falling Star, which deals 3 damage twice, while cheap units that draw you cards trade with your opponent's. Later, Thousand-Tailed Watcher, a 7-cost unit that gives every enemy unit -3 Might the turn it arrives, takes over the battlefields, and Temporal Breach, a spell you hide face down and cast later for free, removes Watcher and plays it again so its effect happens a second time.
builds.whyYou: You'd rather let your opponent commit first and then take their plan apart than race them from turn one. You're happy to spend the early turns burning their units and trading away your cheap ones, because your 6- and 7-cost units come later and take over. Keeping a rune up for your opponent's turn doesn't bore you, and replaying a big unit so its effect fires twice is the kind of turn you play for. If a long game where your opponent runs out of threats sounds better than a fast race, this Kai'Sa suits you.

Formula and judgment differ by 1.5 on Pace (5 vs 3.5) and Stance (4.5 vs 3), under the 2-point re-read line. The formula counts 8 cheap units (Plundering Poro, Watchful Sentry, Pouty Poro) and 20 bodies, but most of those units trade and draw rather than pressure. Cards that decided each Axis. Pace: about 10 cards costing 5+ (3 Thousand-Tailed Watcher, 2 Singularity, 2 Brynhir Thundersong, Ferrous Forerunner, Progress Day, Time Warp) against 8 cheap units. Stance: 16 answers (11 removal: Hextech Ray, Falling Star, Singularity, Bellows Breath, Brittle Steel, Void Seeker; plus Temporal Breach and Brynhir) against about 8.5 pressure. Complexity: 6 reactive cards (Stupefy, Temporal Breach) and 12 card-flow cards (Watchful Sentry, Lecturing Yordle, Stupefy, Progress Day), plus the Legend's timing. Variance: playsets at a 0.6 share, 11 removal, 12 draw cards, and no luck or swing cards. Legend ability: exhaust Kai'Sa as a reaction to add one rune usable only to play spells. Also played: Ravenbloom Tempo Kai'Sa, a more unit-heavy version with Ravenbloom Student, Darius, Trifarian and Inferna in place of Temporal Breach, Bellows Breath and Pouty Poro.
